t: 但丁·阿利吉耶里被缺席宣判并被流放出佛罗伦萨.
te: Dante Alighieri is condemned in absentia and exiled from Florence.
dz: 但丁·阿利吉耶里被缺席宣判并被流放出佛罗伦萨.
de: Dante Alighieri is condemned in absentia and exiled from Florence.

t: 布鲁日·马廷斯(Bruges Matins),法国驻布鲁日军区被当地佛兰德民兵成员所屠杀.
te: Bruges Matins, the nocturnal massacre of the French garrison in Bruges by members of the local Flemish militia.
dz: 布鲁日·马廷斯(Bruges Matins),法国驻布鲁日军区被当地佛兰德民兵成员所屠杀.
de: Bruges Matins, the nocturnal massacre of the French garrison in Bruges by members of the local Flemish militia.

t: 金口之战(荷兰语:Guldensporenslag): 围绕弗拉芒城市的联盟击败了法国国王的皇…
te: Battle of the Golden Spurs (Guldensporenslag in Dutch): A coalition around the Flemish cities defeats the king of Franc…
dz: 金口之战(荷兰语:Guldensporenslag): 围绕弗拉芒城市的联盟击败了法国国王的皇家军队.
de: Battle of the Golden Spurs (Guldensporenslag in Dutch): A coalition around the Flemish cities defeats the king of France's royal army.

t: 决定性地奥斯曼战胜了拜占庭人为土耳其征服开放了比特希尼亚.
te: Decisive Ottoman victory over the Byzantines opening up Bithynia for Turkish conquest.
dz: 巴菲斯战役:决定性地奥斯曼战胜了拜占庭人为土耳其征服开放了比特希尼亚.
de: Battle of Bapheus: Decisive Ottoman victory over the Byzantines opening up Bithynia for Turkish conquest.

t: 阿拉贡的弗雷德里克三世和查理斯,瓦卢瓦伯爵签下"卡尔塔贝略塔之和"(Peace of Calt…
te: Frederick III of Aragon and Charles, Count of Valois sign the Peace of Caltabellotta, which ends the War of the Sicilia…
dz: 阿拉贡的弗雷德里克三世和查理斯,瓦卢瓦伯爵签下"卡尔塔贝略塔之和"(Peace of Caltabellotta),结束了西西里卫斯珀斯之战,将旧西西里王国一分为一和半岛一.
de: Frederick III of Aragon and Charles, Count of Valois sign the Peace of Caltabellotta, which ends the War of the Sicilian Vespers and divides the old Kingdom of Sicily into an island portion and a peninsular portion.

t: 拜占庭-威尼斯战争结束.
te: The Byzantine–Venetian War comes to an end.
dz: 拜占庭-威尼斯战争结束.
de: The Byzantine–Venetian War comes to an end.

t: 教宗博尼法斯八世发行了教宗公牛乌纳姆圣克塔姆,宣称教宗的精神至上.
te: Pope Boniface VIII issues the Papal bull Unam sanctam, claiming spiritual supremacy for the papacy.
dz: 教宗博尼法斯八世发行了教宗公牛乌纳姆圣克塔姆,宣称教宗的精神至上.
de: Pope Boniface VIII issues the Papal bull Unam sanctam, claiming spiritual supremacy for the papacy.
